notes: A lilting 6/8 tide that starts below the home note, on the sixth, climbs by step to the third and holds it a whole bar, then slips down past the start to the fifth below. A little wistful; it begins on the minor chord. Spring: D major, bright piano; the bed comes in for the answer, a flute echoes the held note, harp touches the cadences.
